hotspots.title: Isiolo–Samburu banditry belt
hotspots.summary: Ambushes on police, herders and firewood collectors from 16 September, followed by protests and a security operation. The deadliest cluster of the month.

hotspots.title: Nairobi–Nakuru highway
hotspots.summary: The Kikopey bus crash that killed five members of one family, a lorry ramming a stalled car near Naivasha, and an SUV crash that exposed a Ksh 7.2m bhang haul.

hotspots.title: Nairobi–Mombasa highway
hotspots.summary: A matatu crash near Kapiti and a Dreamline bus hitting a trailer. Both involved public transport.

hotspots.title: Robberies after cash withdrawals
hotspots.summary: A pattern rather than a place. Victims were followed after withdrawing cash in Ruiru, Murang’a, Nyamira, Kamakis and Kitale.

hotspots.title: Lamu
hotspots.summary: A kidnapping, suspected Al-Shabaab activity against KDF teams, street flooding and protests over the Dangote refinery.

hotspots.title: Kisumu city
hotspots.summary: A building collapse that injured eight, a fatal demolition-site collapse in Obunga, and a robbery spree.

watch.title: El Niño rains
watch.body: Nairobi County says it has mapped 227 flood hotspots and began moving families out of riparian areas on 29 September. The governor has raised possible school closures. Flood and landslide warnings were also issued for Kajiado's satellite towns, Kirinyaga, Budalangi in Busia, Mandera, Siaya, Sondu, Tana River and Lamu.
watch.action: If you live near a river or drainage channel, know your nearest high ground now. Check the Deckwatch map and Kenya Meteorological Department alerts before travelling in heavy rain.

watch.title: Isiolo–Samburu security operation
watch.body: A run of bandit attacks, killings and protests across Isiolo, Samburu and northern Meru was followed by a security operation that residents say killed hundreds of their animals. The operation was still running at month’s end.
watch.action: Travel on the Isiolo–Marsabit road and around Gotu and Waso only with current local information.

watch.title: The two big highways
watch.body: Nairobi–Nakuru and Nairobi–Mombasa saw five serious incidents and 13 reported deaths between them. Most involved buses, matatus or heavy trucks.
watch.action: Avoid night travel on these roads where you can. Report dangerous PSV driving to NTSA.

watch.title: Robberies after cash withdrawals
watch.body: Five robberies in five counties followed victims who had just withdrawn cash, from Ksh 600,000 to Ksh 3.9 million. In one, the robbers posed as police officers.
watch.action: Move large sums by bank transfer or M-Pesa rather than cash. Vary your route and timing when you leave a bank.

watch.title: Political gatherings ahead of 2027
watch.body: Two people died at a political meeting in Embu and one during a rally in Nairobi. Police say they are now mapping election-violence hotspots.
watch.action: Before attending a rally, check the venue and surrounding routes on Deckwatch, and plan a way out.

watch.title: Lamu refinery
watch.body: Residents protested the day before the Dangote refinery groundbreaking over land compensation. Court cases are pending and the government says the project will go ahead.
watch.action: Expect more demonstrations around project milestones and court dates in Lamu.

headlines.month: A violent fortnight in the north, and deadly roads everywhere else
headlines.what: Crime and security made up half of all incidents. Road crashes killed the most people.
